info.title: API.SH: Semantic Scholar
info.description: The Semantic Scholar API from API.SH: public Semantic Scholar data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Papers that cite a paper, with the sentences where they cite it (citation contexts), each context's intent (background, methodology, result) and whether the citation is influential. Each paper has id, title, abstract, TLDR, year, venue, authors, citation and reference counts and fields of study. The answer has the total and the count per intent. 10 per page. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/semantic-scholar-citations

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Paper id: a Semantic Scholar id (40 hex characters), `CorpusId:<n>`, `DOI:<doi>`, `ARXIV:<id>`, `PMID:<n>`, `PMCID:<id>`, `MAG:<n>`, `ACL:<id>`, `URL:<link>`, a bare DOI or arXiv id, or a semanticscholar.org / doi.org / arxiv.org link.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order.

parameters.name: intent
parameters.description: Only citations with this intent.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, from 1.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Searches Semantic Scholar's index of scholarly papers with the filters the site offers. Each result has the paper id, corpus id, title, abstract, TLDR summary, year, publication date, venue, journal (volume, pages), authors with author ids, citation count, influential citation count, reference count, citation velocity, citations per year, fields of study, DOI, open-access status and link, publisher and alternate links and badges, plus `raw`. The answer also carries authors whose name matches the query and facet counts (fields of study, publication types, venues, authors, years, papers with a PDF). 10 results per page, up to page 100. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/semantic-scholar-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order of results.

parameters.name: year_from
parameters.description: Only works from this year on.

parameters.name: year_to
parameters.description: Only works up to this year.

parameters.name: fields_of_study
parameters.description: Comma-separated fields: computer-science, medicine, chemistry, biology, materials-science, physics, geology, psychology, art, history, geography, sociology, business, political-science, economics, philosophy, mathematics, engineering, environmental-science, agricultural-and-food-sciences, education, law, linguistics.

parameters.name: publication_type
parameters.description: Comma-separated types: review, journal_article, case_report, clinical_trial, conference, dataset, editorial, letters_and_comments, meta_analysis, news, study, book, book_section.

parameters.name: venue
parameters.description: Comma-separated venue names as in `facets.venues`, e.g. Nature.

parameters.name: author
parameters.description: Comma-separated author names as in `facets.authors`.

parameters.name: has_pdf
parameters.description: true: only papers with a readable PDF.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, from 1 (at most 100).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
